claims: "Mr. Arking discusses the history and customs surrounding the recitation of the daily Mzmore" - The transcript does not mention a speaker named Mr. Arking.
summary: Mr. Arking discusses the history and customs surrounding the recitation of the daily Mzmore and the following Hoshianu verses. He examines various sources regarding whether Hoshianu should be omitted on Fridays and Erev Yom Tob, and explores the reasons provided by different authorities.

How does the custom on Erev Yom Tob compare to the custom on Fridays regarding Hoshianu?
